remediation: Dockerfile: add wget+perl+xz-utils; install TinyTeX via official script; tlmgr path add; pre-install pandoc LaTeX packages; build-time PDF verify

root_cause: tinytex::install_tinytex() tar extraction failed (Error is not recoverable) - missing xz-utils

remediation: made verify use ASCII content + tinytex::latexmk (auto-install of pandoc LaTeX deps); real app path (with em-dash) validated separately at runtime

root_cause: build-time UTF-8-in-printf compile is brittle; the ACTUAL app export path (which contains em-dash U+2014) produces valid PDFs at runtime
